batch_size_probe.selection: largest batch passing one complete V3 optimization step on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and Pi0

scheduling: work-conserving dependency pipeline; patch jobs have queue priority and ready evaluations fill every remaining idle GPU

gpu_admission.patch_admission_policy: attempt immediately once the model-loading floor is available; use real one-step OOM results to select batch size

model_adaptation.openvla: DINOv2 and SigLIP branches with cross-branch relation consistency
model_adaptation.openvla_oft: DINOv2 and SigLIP branches with cross-branch relation consistency; separate primary and wrist patches
model_adaptation.pi0: single SigLIP branch with transformation consistency and token-relation disruption; cross-branch term omitted; separate primary and wrist patches

startup_validation: probe from batch size 32 up to 64 or down to 16, select the largest common passing batch, then run one formal optimization-step validation per model
